title: Apple adds 'face unlock' to the iPhone Duo, but it's not Face ID | TechCrunch
summary: With Monday’s release of iOS 27.3 beta for developers, Apple is addressing that complaint with a new “face unlock” feature that lets iPhone Duo users unlock their phones using the front camera, rather than waiting for a future hardware upgrade.
